id="components"><button type="button" class="odv-qsec-h" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="components-body"><span class="odv-qsec-t">Components</span><span class="odv-qsec-n">5 answers, 1 decision, and the values of its tokens</span></button><div class="odv-qsec-b" id="components-body" hidden><div class="odv-qa" id="components-roles"><div class="odv-q">Which component families does it need?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Core, plus content and media</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Product teams build sign-up and account forms, plus product pages with questions and faces.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>What is the main content? → Forms and tasks</li><li>Who maintains the system? → A platform team</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-count"><div class="odv-q">How far does the inventory reach?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">What today's screens use, plus what the next ones will likely need</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Three product teams find their next parts ready, kept by one platform team.</p></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">Because of</b><ul class="odv-tree"><li>Who maintains the system? → A platform team</li><li>How fast does it change? → Every month</li></ul></li><li><b class="odv-lbl">What it decided</b><p class="odv-why">It sets the values of the components tokens: <a href="foundations/components">Components →</a></p></li></ul></li></ul></div><div class="odv-qa" id="components-definition"><div class="odv-q">How does a component earn its place?</div><ul class="odv-tree odv-tree-root"><li><span class="odv-apill">Its family is in the roles, so product teams find it ready</span><ul class="odv-tree"><li><b class="odv-lbl">Why</b><p class="odv-why">Product teams find a whole family ready instead
